footnote_text: Each share is represented by a restricted stock unit (RSU). Each RSU represents the contingent right to receive, following vesting, one share of Common Stock of the Issuer. 100% of the RSUs shall vest on the earlier of November 18, 2027 or the day prior to the the date of the Issuer's next annual meeting of stockholders, subject to the Reporting Person continuing through such date as a Service Provider, as defined under the Issuer's 2025 Equity Incentive Plan.
